Fixed an issue where Pandora's Bench would take/return double the units from the available champion pool. For example if you roll a two-star Sett into a two-star Aphelios, instead of being +3/-3 copies moving in the pool it would be +6 and then -6. As long as you kept rolling the pool would fix itself and return to normal, but it would temporarily alter pool contents.

Elderwood Lifeblossom Summon can no longer be benched by a Bot during Planning Phase

Fixed a Double Up issue where Random Item Component icon displayed a Rabadon's Deathcap, which is not a random nor an Item Component.
Fixed an Issue where 3-star Ashe was broken after being Polymorphed
Champion names no longer display with an incorrect linebreak when dragging items onto them
Removed extra space around the shop lock tooltip
Fixed an issue where a Unit obtained from the Carousel would rarely disappear after coming back from Carousel round. Where did they go?
Fixed an issue where purchase VO would be played when starring up a Champion during Planning Phase
Fixed an issue where a bot could somehow bench their Lifeblossom Elderwood summon during Planning Phase.
Fixed an issue where Enemy Units' HP bars had a small chance to appear above Friendly Units during Combat
Blackthorn Trait description displays incorrect stats at level 6 and does not say it sacrifices the unit. It does. But you get a lot of stats.
Finally found out the source of an issue where PvE units were entirely missing from a PvE round and fixed it. Thanks for the reports on this one, it was tricky to hunt down with how sporadic it was.
Giant's Belt icon no longer renders at low resolution when equipped
Fixed an issue where the minimize UI button can void selected Augment when clicked right after the Augment selection phase
Fixed an issue where the Chat Box would collapse upon opening and clicking the scroll bar

Fixed an issue where certain Armories could overlap with the Shop after reconnecting back to a match
Fixed an issue where Units sold by dragging and dropping them above the XP/Reroll UI would sometimes fail to be sold.
